description: This PHP class models an employee's membership in an HR management system, mapping to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail'. It includes properties for employee details, membership info, subscription fees, payment details, and relevant dates, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeMembership
classes.description: Represents an employee's membership details, including membership type, subscription fees, payment info, and relevant dates, mapping to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the membership record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the membership record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this membership.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this membership.

methods.name: getMembership
methods.description: Returns the Membership entity associated with this record.

methods.name: setMembership
methods.description: Associates a Membership entity with this record.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Returns who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Sets who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency used for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the subscription commenced.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the subscription commenced.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the renewal date of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Sets the renewal date of the subscription.
